items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: a clarinet player by the name of Bill Bourgeois. Well, of course, Bill is still active today.

ctx.x: Von Gammon then became leader and they had, let's see, they had Harry Shields, who was a brother of Larry Shields playing in the band. And we had an old banjo player by the name of Buzzy Willards, who was very good, and a trumpet player by the name of Bill Gillum, and a clarinet player by the name of Bill Bourgeois. Well, of course, Bill is still active today.

items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Harry Shields. Bill Bourgeois. Of course, Raymond. Raymond Burke.

ctx.x: Who were some of the clarinet players you remember as outstanding? We've already mentioned Aaron and now. Harry Shields.

Harry Shields. Bill Bourgeois. Of course, Raymond. Raymond Burke. And then, of course, to get back to piano players, another fine piano player just entered my mind. A little fella that used to play with Raymond at the Club Plantation. Oh, Julia Chavez. Mm-hmm. Julia Chavez was a good, very good, very good jazz piano player. Played very nice style.
